messages:
oncall-bot: [PAGER] Sev 2 - Customer 'AcmeCorp' (VPC:d-prod-01, pool:dedicated-gpu-4) tool/function-calling errors detected 11:02 UTC. 120 failures in last 2m. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1719472568 :rotating_light:

maria: ack'ing, I'm on it. pulling logs from d-prod-01 now.

ashok: seeing a spike, looks like parser/validator started rejecting function calls after the parser v2 rollout. sample error from runtime:
```
2026-02-22T11:02:17Z ERROR function_call: ParserError: schema mismatch: expected "user_id" string but got number
payload: {"fn": "record_event", "args": {"user_id": 12345, "event": "signup"}}
```

sophie: we deployed parser v2 yesterday to staging and promoted to canary on dedicated yesterday evening. Did we enable strict type enforcement by default?

ashok: yes, default is strict in v2. It rejects ints for strings. Looks like some customers have older clients sending numeric ids.

maria: customer is on a private VPC with dedicated pool. Impact: failing function-calling only; normal text outputs still succeed. Customers report downstream webhook failures.

kate: mitigation idea: flip routing for AcmeCorp to fallback model `redwood-compat-no-fc` (no function-calling) until we can patch adapters. That preserves response but avoids rejected calls.

maria: can do a routing change via API. Command:
```
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.run/v1/routing/override" -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"tenant":"acmecorp","route_to":"redwood-compat-no-fc","reason":"parser-v2-strict-compat-issue"}'
```

ashok: alternative quick patch: deploy hotfix to parser to tolerate numeric->string coercion for `user_id` and similar fields. Risk: may mask real schema errors. Prefer routing fallback first.

tj: I'm going to enact the routing fallback and open a support ticket to AM to notify AcmeCorp. Doing it now.

oncall-bot: routing change requested by tj at 11:05 UTC. Job id: job-7921. Patch in progress :hourglass_flowing_sand:

tj: job-7921 completed successfully. Verified 30 minutes of function call successes for AcmeCorp, error rate dropped to 0.2%.

account-manager-bot: AM notified. Support ticket created SUP-8792: https://redwood.support/SUP-8792. Notifying customer rep Jenna.

sophie: created rollback PR to remove strict enforcement from parser v2; PR: https://git.redwood/repo/parse/PR-451

maria: handoff - I'm going offline in 15m. tj, can you take ownership for ongoing customer comms and follow-up postmortem?

tj: taking it. I'll add postmortem owners and schedule oncall handoff notes. Assigning postmortem to ashok+sophie+maria. ETA initial incident writeup 3h.

maria: thanks. quick checklist: 1) routing fallback applied 2) support ticket opened 3) hotfix PR queued 4) monitor 24h for regressions

tj: noted. I'm keeping the incident open and will update Slack thread when we merge the hotfix. Handoff at 11:20 UTC :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident still open. Severity downgraded to Sev 3 at 11:18 UTC. Next update due by 12:00 UTC.
